claim_boundary: Static source-integrity input only. Matching hashes bind the editable source and contract but do not assert CadQuery execution, FCStd/STEP creation, assembly receipt, manufacturing release, material, seal, pump curve, tolerance, mass-property, pressure, or vehicle-readiness proof.

verification.update_rule: Update this manifest in the same reviewed change whenever editable source or contract changes. A matching hash cannot authorize CadQuery execution or export.
